title: Understanding the Scree Plot
text: The scree plot shows the explained variance ratio for each principal component. Look for a point where the explained variance starts to level off. This is often called the 'elbow' of the plot.

title: Interpreting the Elbow
text: In the scree plot, the 'elbow' is where the explained variance ratio significantly drops and then levels off. This point helps determine the number of principal components to use.

title: Choosing the Number of Components
